title: Agent-Guided Discovery of Exchange-Correlation Functionals with Physics-based Validation
summary: An LLM-agent-guided symbolic search over exchange-correlation functionals, with self-consistent physics filters and held-out and external validation, selected the O159 functional, which retains an 11.7% held-out error improvement over ωB97M-V and comparable performance on the external GSCDB137 set. The result is a computational chemistry functional candidate, without experimental validation.
ai_technology: LLM-agent-guided symbolic search of density-functional exchange-correlation forms.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Agent-derived O159 was evaluated self-consistently on held-out MGCDB84 and on 36 GSCDB137 datasets; it improved held-out error versus ωB97M-V, while remaining computational rather than experimental validation.
evidence.unknown: External generalization, independent replication and downstream real-world impact were not established by the reviewed source.
evidence.ai_role: Frontier LLM agents propose exchange-correlation functional forms evaluated through a GPU fitting and self-consistent physics workflow.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
